description: This Java class 'EntityTagMatcherValueValidator' is a specialized validator for checking the validity of entity tag values within headers, throwing exceptions if validation fails. It is part of a package related to header validation in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: EntityTagMatcherValueValidator
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractHeaderValueValidator that validates whether a CharSequence is a valid entity tag according to EntityTagMatcher.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of EntityTagMatcherValueValidator with a predicate matching EntityTagMatcher class.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a new instance of EntityTagMatcherValueValidator with a provided predicate for responsibility determination.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Overrides a method to validate if the provided value is a valid entity tag, throwing DittoHeaderInvalidException if invalid.
